pages.scan: Wide top panel: caption top-left 'A busy day at Dr. Ananya's clinic.' with a small ananya face box in the centre (silent establishing shot). Bottom-left panel: meera balloon at top-left 'Appointments, patient details, follow-ups...', then a meera balloon below her face 'I wish everything were easier to manage!'. Bottom-right panel: ananya balloon at top 'Our time belongs with patients. Let's make the rest simpler.'
pages.observation: Risk of skipping a line: Ananya's reply balloon in the right panel sits at the same height as Meera's first balloon. Meera's second balloon ('I wish...') is much lower, under her face. A reader on the top line of this tier can go straight from 'Appointments...' across to 'Our time belongs...' and only then drop back to 'I wish...', so the reply comes before the complaint it answers. Raise Meera's second balloon or lower Ananya's balloon. Meera has no role or introduction (the caption only names Dr. Ananya). Ananya and Meera are in separate panels, so it is unclear whether they share a room. The tall bottom-left panel has a lot of empty space below the second balloon. Panel 1 has a small face and no action, so the 'busy' in the caption has to come from the art.
